LanguageData.LP_RelentlessEndurance.label: gritting teeth
LanguageData.LP_RelentlessEndurance.description: Holding on through sheer grit. Pain won't shock them into falling, and consciousness won't drop below about 30%. When the effect ends, injuries resolve as usual.
LanguageData.LP_RelentlessCooldown.label: relentless cooldown
LanguageData.LP_RelentlessCooldown.description: Just gritted their teeth through it once. Relentless Endurance won't trigger again until the cooldown ends.
LanguageData.LP_DwarfUnderMountain.label: in the mountain's belly
LanguageData.LP_DwarfUnderMountain.description: Thick rock overhead; a dwarf in their element.
